name: Pedro Tabuada Invites Bikas
description: Pedro Tabuada invites Bikas to Era Uma Vez no Porto for a night of techno and house music. This event marks a return to the roots of the R4W project, featuring both artists who started it.
longDescription:
Pedro Tabuada invites Bikas to Era Uma Vez no Porto for a special night of techno and house music. The event is scheduled for Wednesday, 18 November, starting at 11:59 PM and running until 6:00 AM.

This gathering is a return to the origins of the R4W project, which Bikas helped establish alongside Pedro Tabuada. The lineup features both Bikas (Strings Records) and Pedro Tabuada.

Tickets are available in several releases, with prices ranging from €5.00 for Community Tickets to €10.00 for the 2nd Release. The venue is located at Rua da Madeira 126, 4000-330 Porto, Portugal.
